title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ygp9: bitmap convention mismatch between write_to and from_bytes_for
description:
## Bug: bitmap bit-position convention mismatch between write_to and from_bytes_for

### Location
`rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs` — `Ack::write_to` (line 283) and `Ack::from_bytes_for` (lines 318, 324, 329)

### Root Cause
`write_to` maps wire position p to bitmap bit `WINDOW_SIZE - 1 - p` (= `31 - p`, i.e., FCN 62 → bitmap bit 31), while `from_bytes_for` maps wire position p to bitmap bit `62 - p` (FCN 62 → bitmap bit 62). BITMAP_MASK only covers bits 0..31, which masks the 62..33 bits to zero, causing the canonical check in from_bytes_for to reject every non-complete ACK.

### Detailed Trace
write_to checks: `self.bitmap & (1u64 << (WINDOW_SIZE - 1 - position)) != 0` (line 283)
from_bytes_for sets: `bitmap |= 1u64 << (62 - position)` (lines 319, 325, 330)

For position 0 (first wire bitmap bit, representing FCN 62):
- write_to checks bitmap bit `1u64 << 31`
- from_bytes_for sets bitmap bit `1u64 << 62`

After `Self::new(data[0], window, bitmap, false)` applies BITMAP_MASK (0xFFFF_FFFF), bits 62..32 are discarded. write_to then checks bits 31..0 — which are all zero — producing a canonical format with no bits set. The canonical check `&canonical[..length] != data` fails for any ACK with bits set in the bitmap.

### Verification
Walk through a 6-byte ACK with rule_id=0x78, window=0, and one bitmap bit at position 0 (first fragment ACKed): wire `[0x78, 0x20, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00]`

1. from_bytes_for reconstructs bitmap = 0x4000_0000_0000_0000 (bit 62)
2. Self::new masks to BITMAP_MASK → bitmap = 0
3. write_to on the masked bitmap produces `[0x78, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00]`
4. Canonical check fails: input `0x20` ≠ output `0x00` → NonCanonicalAck

### Fix
Change `(62 - position)` to `(WINDOW_SIZE - 1 - position)` on lines 319, 325, and 330.

### Test Gap
No roundtrip tests exist for non-complete ACK serialization/deserialization (write_to → from_bytes_for). Existing tests (literal_ack_and_controls) only test complete ACKs (C=1), which take the early-return path in from_bytes_for and bypass the bitmap code.

### Priority Justification
P0 (priority 1 in bd): This prevents any non-complete ACK from being deserialized correctly, breaking the entire SCHC ACK-on-Error retransmission mechanism. All non-complete ACK processing in FragmentSender::handle_ack_bytes would fail with NonCanonicalAck.
